literal_meaning: বাপের জন্মকাল বা জীবনকালে (in the father's birth or lifetime)
figurative_meaning_bn: কখনও; কোনকালে, কোনদিন; নিজের জন্মেতো নয়ই এমনকি আগের কালও নয়
figurative_meaning_en: Never; at any time or day; not even in one's own lifetime, let alone in previous eras
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি এটা করবে? বাপের জন্মে না!
example_sentences_in_english: Such an incident never happened in my father's lifetime.
You will do that? Not in my father's lifetime!
note: This idiom emphasizes generational improbability, common in oral Bengali traditions
